items.title: Help inside BBS
items.text: McHorse's guide plays right here, chapter by chapter. Shift+F1 opens the chapter for the editor you're in, or the short clip of the feature under the mouse. Show me points at where each feature lives now.

items.title: Recording guide
items.text: Mark where and when each actor starts; the markers count the seconds down while you record.

items.title: Voice-over
items.text: Record your voice straight onto the film's timeline, also while a replay is recording.

items.title: DaVinci Resolve tab
items.text: Resolve inside BBS with both timelines in step. Projects with your own timelines are never written to.

items.title: Texture Studio
items.text: Paint a model's texture in Photopea with a live 3D preview beside it (needs the Rinku mod).

items.title: Held model block
items.text: Animate the model block in your first-person hand as its own Held replay.

items.title: Film tiles
items.text: Move the mouse across a film tile to scrub through the film.

items.title: Smooth UI scale
items.text: The UI scale slider changes the size smoothly instead of in steps.
